Chapter 1229 - 36: Ownership Of The Treasure Land (Subscription Request)

Chapter 1229: Chapter 36: Ownership of the Treasure Land (Subscription Request)

Red Flame Venerable followed behind Lin Yuan, also overlooking the many Peak Venerables below.

However, Red Flame Venerable’s gaze was slightly dazed; along the way, only he saw how Galaxy Venerate truly ’swept away’ the numerous top-tier Peak Venerables.

That unstoppable crushing momentum almost made Red Flame Venerable think he was dreaming.

Especially when many top-tier Peak Venerables directly activated ultimate killing weapons, the terrifying power burst forth, but in front of Lin Yuan, they still seemed like thin paper easily pierced through.

It made Red Flame Venerable’s heart tremble.

"Galaxy..."

Red Flame Venerable looked at the young man standing in front of him, his expression slightly dazed, finally understanding the meaning of ’sweeping away.’

...

"Galaxy Venerate?"

In front of the third giant core pillar, including Fu Xu Venerate, all the Peak Venerables looked up, like a mayfly seeing the blue sky.

In just three or four breaths, one hundred and three core pillars were seized, and on the field, at least one main battle physique of top-tier Peak Venerables fell into Galaxy Venerate’s hands.

Knowing the despair and impotence faced when confronting Galaxy Venerate.

Especially the later fallen top-tier Peak Venerables, they did not have the lack of defense the earlier fallen ones did.

These top-tier Peak Venerables were very cautious, directly activating ultimate killing weapons, but still got crushed and shattered.

"Galaxy Venerate, what do you intend to do?"

Fu Xu Venerate took a deep breath, steadied his mind, and asked.

Even at this moment, regardless of how unbelievable, he couldn’t reveal it; otherwise, the morale of the many Peak Venerables on his side might collapse directly.

"What do you intend to do?"

Lin Yuan looked at Fu Xu Venerate, shook his head, and said, "Surrender all core pillars."

Compared to other top-tier Peak Venerables, Fu Xu Venerate was harder to deal with; Lin Yuan was currently locking onto the location of his true form.

Don’t be fooled by Fu Xu Venerate standing there; in fact, his true form was merged into layers of space-time, and hidden with the power of Da Fu Ancient Country’s ultimate killing weapon, making Lin Yuan have to work hard to lock onto it.

The foundational killing weapon made by ancestors, when placed in the hands of top-tier Peak Venerables, shows a completely different power spectrum compared to when in the hands of the Strongest Venerable like Fu Xu Venerate.

Especially the ultimate killing weapon activated by Fu Xu Venerate was not an ordinary foundational killing weapon.

"Surrender all core pillars?"

Fu Xu Venerate’s face looked ugly, "That’s impossible."

Surrendering all core pillars equaled giving up the contention for this treasure land.

For Fu Xu Venerate, that was an unacceptable result.

"If it’s impossible, then go die."

Lin Yuan said in a serene tone.

Before the words were finished, he stretched out his right hand and grabbed towards Fu Xu Venerate.

Rumblings.

Invisible and majestic power of space-time swept through.

Fu Xu Venerate’s expression changed dramatically, immediately sensing that his true form hidden in the depths of space-time must have been discovered and locked onto by Galaxy Venerate.

"This Galaxy Venerate can so easily lock onto my true form?"

Fu Xu Venerate was incredulous; he used the power of the ancient country’s ultimate killing weapon to hide his true form’s location, even the strongest Venerables of the same level couldn’t lock it, equivalent to being Innately undefeated.

The strength displayed by Galaxy Venerate obviously surpasses the strongest Venerables; Fu Xu Venerate wasn’t planning to use this move to counter Galaxy Venerate but at least to hold on a bit longer.

But how long had passed? Less than five breaths and his true form was found?

"Block!"

Fu Xu Venerate’s aura suddenly exploded, a surge of inexplicable energy ascended, all coming from the Da Fu Ancient Country’s ultimate killing weapon, attempting to counter Lin Yuan’s grab.

But unfortunately.

The barriers formed by various inexplicable energies shattered easily under Lin Yuan’s grab.

But at least it sustained Fu Xu Venerate for a bit of breathing room.

As the Strongest Venerable, he ultimately exceeded the many top-tier Peak Venerables, not collapsing at the first touch before Lin Yuan.

"If you don’t take action now, this treasure land will fall into Galaxy Venerate’s hands."

Fu Xu Venerate immediately transmitted to Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, Spirit Prison Venerable, and other top-tier Peak Venerables.

Before this, several ancient countries had completed transactions, fully binding together.

If Da Fu Ancient Country gains this treasure land, Xuanyin Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country could still salvage a bit.

But if Fierce Sun Ancient Country gains this treasure land, not to mention salvage, Xuanyin Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country might not even make it out alive.

"Fu Xu, don’t worry, our true forms are on their way."

Spirit Prison Venerable, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, and other leading Venerables from various ancient countries spoke solemnly.

Although they were quite regretful at the moment, knowing Galaxy Venerate was so strong, they surely wouldn’t have proposed such excessive demands, but since things had already happened, they had no choice.

Only to join Fu Xu Venerate in a desperate battle.

Combining the forces of the leading top-tier Peak Venerables from Da Fu, Xuanyin, Da Ling, and Thunder four ancient countries, holding ultimate killing weapons, to confront Galaxy Venerate.

Rumblings.

In the distance.

Spirit Prison Venerable, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, and other leading Venerables activated ultimate killing weapons, attacking towards Lin Yuan from afar, terrifying power burst forth, annihilating large portions of space-time.

All leading Venerables attacked with full force, holding nothing back.

"Hmm?"

The space-time around Lin Yuan twisted, and all the attacks were like stones falling into the sea. He cast a glance at the leading Peak Venerable figures in the distance.

"No use at all?"

Spirit Prison Venerable, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, and the other leading Venerables’ hearts trembled.

With Fu Xu Venerate desperately holding off the Galaxy Venerate, they seized the chance to launch a surprise attack. However, they couldn’t even stir a ripple, let alone shake the Galaxy Venerate.

This left the leading Venerables in utter despair.

Previously, when Lin Yuan killed the main battle body guarding them and seized the core pillar, they witnessed the terrifying attack power of the Galaxy Venerate. Not a single top Peak Venerable could withstand the Galaxy Venerate even for a moment.

Even activating their fundamental killing weapons for defense was useless.

And now, the leading Venerables were aware of the Galaxy Venerate’s almost undefeatable defensive power.

Their strike with full power utilizing their fundamental killing weapon was effortlessly blocked by the Galaxy Venerate?

It was blocked, not dodged; the difference between the two is significant.

If it was dodged, the leading Venerables would feel a bit better since it would at least indicate that their attack had some effect, prompting the Galaxy Venerate to dodge.

But directly blocking it...

It meant the Galaxy Venerate didn’t care about their attacks at all.

"Galaxy Venerate!"

Fu Xu Venerate also saw this scene, his eyes vaguely swirling with golden power, and the power of time began to completely disorder around him.

This was his strongest killing move, using a certain Secret Technique to combine two Tier Thirteen methods. Although it was far from true fusion, its power exceeded that of a single Tier Thirteen Secret Technique.

Fu Xu Venerate had never used this move since creating it, saving it as his final trump card.

"Time!"

After activating the killing move, pure strands of temporal power appeared in front of Fu Xu Venerate. This power originated from the treasure vault of the Da Fu Ancient Country, specially refined by the Da Fu Ancestor.

Any time-related killing move, when bolstered by these strands of temporal Origin Source, would have its power dramatically increased.

"This is my strongest method."

Fu Xu Venerate looked towards Lin Yuan, as the disordered temporal power was spreading towards him.

Setting aside the combined Tier Thirteen methods, just the strands of temporal Origin Source alone cost Fu Xu Venerate an enormous amount of effort.

If this treasured land wasn’t so precious, and not related to time, aligning with Fu Xu Venerate’s path, he wouldn’t even consider using those temporal Origin Sources.

"This temporal power?" Lin Yuan also sensed the disordered time.

For ordinary top Peak Venerables, under the influence of this ever-spreading disordered time, they would likely succumb immediately, perceiving a moment where a thousand years passed outside.

Even the Strongest Venerable would be greatly affected, possibly losing this body unexpectedly.

After all, this killing move wasn’t just Fu Xu Venerate’s power but also borrowed the temporal Origin Source that only the Ancestor could refine.

But Lin Yuan—

The disorderly time swept over Lin Yuan like a torrent crashing against a giant stone weighing tens of thousands of tons, unable to move him a bit.

"Want to affect me with time? If the Ancestor stepped in, maybe."

Lin Yuan gently shook his head.

His foundational strength was immeasurably deep and heavy, precisely countering these time-related techniques.

Time is like a flowing river, and a being’s foundational strength is akin to the weight within this river. A stone too heavy can naturally ignore the river’s impact.

"Still no use?"

Fu Xu Venerate looked at the still-standing Galaxy Venerate and turned to flee without hesitation.

Having even his strongest move fail to affect the Galaxy Venerate in the slightest, Fu Xu Venerate knew the situation had been lost, with no hope of seizing the treasured land.

At this moment, Fu Xu Venerate wanted to exit the treasured land peacefully.

Failing to seize the land might cost him even his main battle body.

Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.

In the distance, other leading Venerables and many top Peak Venerables, as well as ordinary Peak Venerables, began to escape.

"Since you all attacked me, you can stay here."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted, and his form suddenly turned into a blazing Fierce Sun, as an invisible power of twisted space-time spread to cover all directions.

Fu Xu Venerate had not fled far before he was impeded by this twisting power, soon being obliterated by Lin Yuan’s attack.

The other leading Venerables, top Peak Venerables, and ordinary Venerables had the same change in expression; space-time quickly twisted, leaving them unable even to traverse the void.

"Ahhh, Galaxy Venerate, I give up on seizing the land."

"Let us go."

Many Peak Venerables sought mercy, knowing that although losing their main battle body didn’t mean true death, cultivating a main battle body was no easy task.

Especially considering this main battle body carried numerous weapons and a thousand years’ worth of gains from this treasured land.

Bang, bang, bang.

Lin Yuan did not hold back. He harbored no goodwill towards the Da Ling Ancient Country, the Xuanyin Ancient Country, and other Ancient Countries, remembering their extortionate behavior.

Soon.

The many Peak Venerables quickly perished.

...

Red Flame Venerable stared blankly at the scene; top Peak Venerables comparable to him crumbled like dust before Lin Yuan, easily erased.

"What is that?" The many Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country only just reacted, sensing the disappearing auras of the Peak Venerables, their hearts filled with shock.

Man Kun Venerable of the Barbaric Wilderness Country was about to find the Galaxy Venerate to discuss how to deal with the Da Fu Ancient Country, but witnessing this scene, his mind was in a daze: "This, is this the Galaxy Venerate?"
